name: Modern Visual SLAM Benchmark
description: Evaluates visual SLAM systems' mapping and localization accuracy, robustness, and representational consistency across standardized datasets and metrics.
evaluation_method: trajectory_error (Absolute Trajectory Error / Relative Pose Error)
reputation: Well-regarded in the visual SLAM and robotics community for standardized comparison of mapping and localization methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; metrics are sensitive to coordinate alignment and dataset selection. Performance varies substantially by sequence and sensor setup; some subsets may approach saturation while others remain challenging.
